summary: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII (HVII), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder vote results from its August 24, 2026 extraordinary general meeting approving its business combination with ONE Nuclear Energy LLC. The filing details proposals passed, including the business combination, with 19,589,191 shares (75.28% quorum) represented. No deal terms, premium, or advisors are disclosed in this excerpt. The registrant is the SPAC issuer facilitating the merger via its subsidiary Solis Merger Sub. This is a routine procedural update on a pending strategic transaction, not a new announcement. Watch for closing conditions and redemptions.
